claims.source_quote_ar: الْمُشْرِكِينَ يعنى الذين نقضوكم وظاهروا عليكم
claims.claim_ar: تقييد عموم لفظ «الْمُشْرِكِينَ» بقيد «الذين نقضوكم وظاهروا عليكم»
claims.claim_en: Restriction of the general term 'al-mushrikīn' to those who violated the covenant and showed hostility against you.
claims.rhetorical_effect: Specifies and limits the scope of the punishment/imperative so it does not apply to all polytheists but only to those who broke their covenant and showed hostility, clarifying justice and restraint.
